source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Medicines & Where to Find Them
source_excerpt:
Players can find medicines scattered across the different regions in Phantom Blade Zero , giving them several ways to replenish their health during challenging encounters. You can equip two medicines at a time, and their charges will replenish to the original amount whenever you interact with a Bell.
There are also other ways to heal yourself, including certain weapons, Phantom Edges , skills, and accessories. Some of these can replenish a medicine charge during combat, while others give you a chance to avoid consuming a charge when using one.
Medicines can also be upgraded after reaching Myst's Tavern in Pangzhen , increasing their healing and, in some cases, the number of charges available.
Available from the start of the game.
From the Axemaster's Holding Cell Bell, head outside and turn left to find this inside a chest.
You can find this inside the base of the Sha-Chi Tower near the location where you can use the Sha-Chi Furnace Inspection Crank to get the Reflex Device accessory.
Use the Crimson Forest Crank near the Outlaw Trap Bell and head down. Descend the ladder, then turn left past the door you can open. You will find the medicine to your left.
After the fight with Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic, and the bridge cutscene, look straight ahead to find this medicine.
From the Well of the Three Puppets Bell, head left. After the red Hokora on your left, take the path into the house and descend the ladder to find the medicine.
Enter the house near the Black Serpent House Bell and climb the ladder to find this medicine.
Defeat Xie Qiudong, the Divine Healer.
Talk to the NPC at the Green Serpent House.
Complete A Mother's Heart , which requires you to use the Backstreet Cellar Crank .
Use the Bashpole near the Battlefield Ruins Bell.
Head up the stairs after the Yubi, No. 21 Swordfighter Puppet boss fight.
Complete Kin against Kin at Meigu Village East Dock.
Find this inside a chest in the Phantom Illusionist Ruins , after the fifth Bell.
Complete Quick Hand's Request in Meigu Lake.
This medicine is found at the Sha-Chi Tower, which unlocks after entering Mirage Estate. From the Crimson Forest Sha-Chi Tower Base Bell, head down the stairs, fight the enemies, and open the chest at the end.
Before heading down to the Training Grounds, look for a path around a wooden log that you can jump over. Take the chain down and continue ahead to find the medicine.
